messages:
Mira: quick check — PR #2894 has two small style nits from CI (gofumpt + proto tag order). I can fix but want to avoid another rebase before merge window.
Alex: can you paste the CI error? wondering if it's just formatting or a behavioral change.
Mira: CI snippet:
```
./pkg/metrics/metrics.go:45:1: file is not gofumpted
pkg/proto/service.pb.go: tags out of order: `json:\"id\"` vs `json:\"id,omitempty\"`
```
Sam: the proto tag thing usually comes from generated pb ordering — did we regenerate after the field rename? If it’s generator, we should re-run `make protos`.
Mira: I didn't regenerate — the PR touched a small struct that affected the proto, so plausible. I can do `make protos` and push an extra commit if folks are okay with that.
Lena: sgtm. if it’s only codegen + gofumpt we can squash before merge.
Raj: heads up — we need 2 approvals for this package. @Alex could you review after Mira pushes the fix? I can be the second approver.
Alex: yep, I’ll take a look once you push. ping me with the commit hash.
Mira: pushing a quick fix now. commands I ran locally:
```
make protos
gofumpt -w ./pkg
git add pkg/proto/service.pb.go pkg/metrics/metrics.go
git commit -m "ci: regenerate protos; apply gofumpt" --no-verify
git push origin pr/2894
```
merge-bot: merge-window check: allowed to merge during next 2h slot if approvals present. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Alex: saw the new commit, LGTM except one tiny varname nit in metrics.go — `cntItems` -> `countItems` for consistency with surrounding code.
Mira: ok will rename and force-push? or add another small commit?
Sam: small rename is fine as an amendment but please avoid force-push if other reviewers are mid-review. another commit + squash on merge is fine.
Mira: pushed rename as separate commit: hash abc1234. @Alex @Raj can you approve when ready? Thanks.
Raj: approved. :thumbsup:
Alex: approved. no runtime changes in CI, all green.
Mira: thanks — I'll queue for merge. plan: squash-merge, include both fixes in commit message, target merge window + merge-bot. closing this thread.
